name: ZwiftGopher TT
description: Ride a ZwiftGopher TT plan in Zwift: the target now, the next change and when, W' and the finish, as a HUD over the game.
author: ZwiftGopher

windows.name: TT HUD: strip
windows.description: One line across the top of the game: target now, next change and when, W' and the finish.

windows.name: TT HUD: dial
windows.description: A round gauge: live power against the target band, W' on the inner ring, the next change below.

windows.name: TT HUD: stack
windows.description: A narrow column for a screen edge: now, next, W' and the finish.

windows.name: TT interval list
windows.description: Every interval of the plan with its target, time, gradient and W', and how each one went.

windows.name: TT field
windows.description: The riders of your event in standings order, with the gap at equal distance, the time you gain or lose on each per minute, speed, w/kg and W'.

windows.name: TT rivals
windows.description: One line for a screen edge: the riders nearest you on the road, ahead and behind, and whether you are gaining or losing on them.
